finding.heading: ### R1-1 Purchase follow-ups ignore the opt-out
finding.body:
The purchase follow-up rule keeps sending marketing notifications to opted-out customers. It contradicts the opt-out rule, which says an opted-out customer receives none. Cited: spec lines 17, 19 (before version).
An implementer who follows NO-4 builds a sender that emails opted-out customers about their recent purchases.
Protected requirement: line 17 (the opt-out must hold).

full_diff:
--- before.md
+++ after.md
@@ -14,9 +14,8 @@
 
 ## 3. Opt-out
 
-- **NO-2 Opt-out.** A customer who opts out of marketing notifications receives none of them, on any channel, from the moment the preference is saved.
+- **NO-2 Opt-out.** Once a customer has saved an opt-out, no marketing notification reaches that customer on any channel.
 - **NO-3 Transactional messages.** Order confirmations, shipping updates and security alerts are not marketing notifications and are always sent.
-- **NO-4 Purchase follow-ups.** Opted-out customers still receive marketing notifications about products they bought in the last 90 days.
 - **NO-5 Unsubscribe link.** Every marketing e-mail contains a link that opts the customer out with one click and without a sign-in.
 
 ## 4. Operations
